shared_contract.conversion_rule: convert source millimetres to stage metres exactly once at scene-authoring time
shared_contract.render_collision_rule: the same mutation parameter record must generate the visible opening and the compound collision geometry; no invisible blocking proxy
shared_contract.terminal_goal_rule: both named actions must be complete; A-only and B-only are always incomplete

tasks.name: small hub cover and headed fastener

action_a.name: seat_cover
action_a.text: Seat the small hub cover on the top casing and register its yaw.

action_b.name: retain_bolt
action_b.text: Insert and quarter-turn the M6 hub bolt into the aligned guide bore.

tasks.goal: Finish with the cover registered and the bolt retained; do not teleport or snap parts.
tasks.initial_state: cover loose beside the casing; bolt loose in a visible rack; guide bore empty

geometry.cutout_recipe: round disk for HARD; union of neck disk, lobe disk, and exact swept shaft locus for COMMUTABLE
geometry.visible_evidence: three openings and the pre-lock lobe are visible in the close camera

HARD.feasibility_reason: 11.70 mm retained head cannot pass a 6.80 mm round opening

COMMUTABLE.feasibility_reason: 13.60 mm lobe admits the 11.70 mm head during the -12 degree pre-lock motion

tasks.name: output-shaft washer and output gear
tasks.purpose: laterally accessible versus covered washer seat

action_a.name: seat_washer
action_a.text: Place the thin washer flat on the output-shaft shoulder.

action_b.name: mount_output_gear
action_b.text: Lower the output gear onto the output shaft and seat it.

tasks.goal: Finish with the washer on the shoulder and the output gear fully seated.
tasks.initial_state: output shaft fixed in the fixture; washer and gear separated on the parts tray

geometry.mutation_surface: the gear-seat shroud, not the washer mesh, is changed
geometry.cutout_recipe: HARD uses a closed annular shroud; COMMUTABLE subtracts a radial side slot whose width exceeds washer thickness plus tolerance
geometry.visible_evidence: the closed shroud or radial slot is visible from the oblique camera

HARD.feasibility_reason: the seated gear covers every vertical and radial path to the washer shoulder

COMMUTABLE.feasibility_reason: the visible 2.00 mm radial slot leaves 0.75 mm clearance over the 1.00 mm washer

tasks.name: output-shaft key and output gear
tasks.purpose: end-closed keyway versus open-ended key access

action_a.name: insert_output_key
action_a.text: Slide the output key fully into the shaft keyway.

action_b.name: mount_output_gear
action_b.text: Mount and seat the output gear over the keyed shaft.

tasks.goal: Finish with the key fully seated and the gear mounted without collision.
tasks.initial_state: keyway entrance and gear bore are visible; key and gear are loose on the tray

geometry.mutation_surface: the outer end of the shaft keyway and matching gear skirt
geometry.cutout_recipe: HARD closes the keyway entrance under the gear footprint; COMMUTABLE leaves a side-open keyway with a 21.00 mm access window
geometry.visible_evidence: the keyway end or side-open window is visible before either action

HARD.feasibility_reason: the mounted gear covers the only key insertion corridor

COMMUTABLE.feasibility_reason: the side-open 21.00 mm window remains reachable after the gear is mounted

tasks.name: casing closure and through-bolt
tasks.purpose: post-closure bore alignment versus captive bolt preload

action_a.name: close_casing
action_a.text: Lower and seat the casing top onto the casing base.

action_b.name: insert_casing_bolt
action_b.text: Insert the M10 casing through-bolt and seat its head.

tasks.goal: Finish with the casing top seated and the through-bolt fully seated.
tasks.initial_state: casing halves separated; bolt visible in its rack; top-side and base-side lugs visible

geometry.mutation_surface: top-side lug around the through-bolt hole
geometry.cutout_recipe: HARD has a blind top lug and continuous bore only after mating; COMMUTABLE adds a visible captive pocket that retains the bolt without blocking mating
geometry.visible_evidence: the blind lug or captive pocket is visible in the top-side close view

HARD.feasibility_reason: the separated lug does not form a continuous through-bore

COMMUTABLE.feasibility_reason: the 18.00 mm visible pocket retains the bolt head with 1.50 mm clearance during closure

tasks.name: casing closure and locating dowel
tasks.purpose: split locating bore versus captive preloaded dowel

action_a.name: close_casing
action_a.text: Lower and seat the casing top onto the casing base.

action_b.name: insert_locating_dowel
action_b.text: Insert the locating dowel into the aligned casing bore.

tasks.goal: Finish with the casing seated and the locating dowel fully inserted and stable.
tasks.initial_state: casing halves separated; dowel upright on the tray; split bore and retaining features visible

geometry.cutout_recipe: HARD uses two half-bores that become continuous only after seating; COMMUTABLE adds a visible open retaining slot sized for the dowel before closure
geometry.visible_evidence: the split bore or open retaining slot is visible from the top-side close view

HARD.feasibility_reason: neither half-bore retains a stable dowel without the mating half

COMMUTABLE.feasibility_reason: the visible 15.20 mm slot retains the 13.80 mm dowel with 0.70 mm diametral clearance
